name: Montserrat
summary: An English colony interrupted by French occupation and local rebellion.
notes: The 1667 Treaty of Breda and the restoration of effective English government in 1668 are separate events. The modern island remains a British Overseas Territory.

events.title: Spain claims Montserrat
events.detail: Columbus named the island after the Catalan monastery.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: An English colony begins
events.detail: Settlers, including Irish colonists, arrived from Saint Kitts.

events.title: French occupation
events.detail: French forces took the colony during the Second Anglo-Dutch War.

events.title: Rebellion after the occupation
events.detail: A local uprising interrupted the transition back to English authority.

events.title: English government re-established
events.detail: The Treaty of Breda’s restitution was followed by effective restoration.

events.title: France takes Montserrat again
events.detail: French forces captured the island during the American Revolutionary War.

events.title: Separate colony
events.detail: Montserrat became a separate colony after the Leeward Islands federation ended.
